limitations: The experimental row nearest the CFD incidence is at 10.10 degrees, not exactly 10.00 degrees.
The distributed force table does not carry a complete measurement-uncertainty budget.
The archived integral CFD table does not include residual, force-monitor or mass-imbalance histories.
The case is aerodynamic; using it as a hydrofoil analogue excludes free-surface, cavitation and medium-specific effects.
Grid-family choice strongly affects the asymptote; only NASA TMR family II is used here.
Observed order and GCI from a monotone three-grid subset do not establish an asymptotic error bound; see Diskin et al. (2015).
